purpose: Discover a published episode, play it from the mini and full player, bookmark, reload and resume, and meet interruption and expired access, while confirming that listening never starts production work.
preconditions: A local or QA Theatre instance the user authorized; never production
At least one published episode with real delivered audio, one library entry with a missing cover and one with a very long title, plus a state with no listening history
A listener test account created through the official flow; no credential in this file
A way to observe, read-only, that no production job is created (a job count or the job list); if unavailable that step is inconclusive

fixtures.long_title: Một lời hẹn dưới ánh đèn cuối cùng của sân khấu nhỏ ở cuối con phố cũ, mùa mưa năm ấy
fixtures.audio: generated tone or permitted sample of known duration; never committed

steps.action: Open discovery and the library and read the first screen.
steps.expected: Cover art, title and availability lead; no oversized banner or gradient; a missing cover and a very long title are both usable; an account with no history has a usable empty state.

steps.action: Open the episode and start playback from its row.
steps.expected: The control reports Loading and then Playing only once audio runs; elapsed and total time are text; the accessible name carries action, item and state.

steps.action: Play, pause and seek repeatedly, then compare the production job count before and after.
steps.expected: No adaptation, synthesis or mixing job is created by listening.

steps.action: Seek with the keyboard and with the pointer, then change playback speed.
steps.expected: Seeking works without relying on a waveform; position and speed are announced as text; an invalid seek leaves a recoverable state.

steps.action: Navigate to another Theatre view and back while the episode plays.
steps.expected: The mini-player persists with play or pause, title, position and an entry to the full player; playback continues; it never covers the focused control.

steps.action: Add a bookmark, reload the page and reopen the episode.
steps.expected: The bookmark survives reload and names its position; the resume prompt states the actual position; no unrelated dialogue is entered silently.

steps.action: Interrupt the network, then let media access expire or use the environment's documented way to simulate it.
steps.expected: A recoverable state distinct from a final failure appears; the position is preserved; recovery offers a clear action; no spinner without end.

steps.action: Look for a draft or unapproved episode in discovery.
steps.expected: No draft or unapproved episode is offered as playable public content.

steps.action: Repeat discovery and the full player at 320 CSS px and 200 % zoom with the keyboard only.
steps.expected: Primary controls remain reachable and labelled; no horizontal page scroll; no clipped Vietnamese diacritics; focus never hides under the mini-player.

forbidden_actions: Starting any production, regeneration or publication action
Downloading media outside the browser's normal playback
Deleting bookmarks, progress or accounts the run did not create
Changing account, sharing or permission settings
cleanup: Remove only the bookmark and progress this run created; retain the fixtures and the account for the recheck.
open_questions: What is the documented way to simulate an expired media URL in the QA environment? Until recorded, that step is inconclusive.
What is the product rule for completion versus restart? The scenario observes and reports the behavior; it does not judge it.
